test_name: Normcore disconnect not recovered, player stuck - c87c5a00-4d18-4ad8-af14-adf190dede44
summary: Passed: in the Joint, after the room connection was dropped, the game reconnected the player to the same room and respawned their mech, and when reconnecting is impossible it now triggers the existing 'connection lost' exit that takes the player out of the server room. Before this, nothing ever tried to reconnect, and if the room failed to connect when the level opened, nothing took the player out of the server room either. The game now retries up to 3 times, and only after that runs the existing exit (leave the server room, show the popup, restart).
instructions:
TASK: when Normal is disconnected, we do not recover it for the player and do not log them out of STDB, so they must restart the game

DESCRIPTION:
[Log GKLH · 15OS ](https://15os.onehamsa.com/logging?code=GKLH)

<https://discord.com/channels/276104181067022336/1529068845317492787>

REQUEST (from Amit):
@Big Sys investigate and fix

JOB TYPE:
BUG FIX - task reports existing behaviour going wrong: when Normal is disconnected it is not recovered and the player is not logged out of STDB, forcing a restart

GAME MODE:
UNSURE - JUDE should decide from game context
verified: Joint join connects to the Normcore room once
a local realtime.Disconnect() (soft-move case) does not start a reconnect
the lost-room path (StartReconnect) reconnects on attempt 1/3 to the same Joint room and respawns the local mech, twice
after adding RequestRespawnAssignment the reconnect respawn has no '[Elevator spawn-in] No spawn assignment' error
reconnect give-up raises OnReconnectFailed and MultiplayerConnectionMonitor requests QuitMultiplayer ('Would quit multiplayer' in editor)
not_done: a real network drop (non-local Normcore disconnect event) was not produced; the event-type filter was read in code, the local branch tested at runtime
failed first connect on scene start (ConnectOnStartAsync) not exercised at runtime
the build-only quit flow (cleanup, STDB LeaveRoom, popup, restart) not seen end to end: the editor skips it by design; it is the existing unchanged QuitMultiplayer
reconnect mid-match in an arena (Rumble, cage) not tested; only the Joint
session log GKLH could not be opened from the cloud machine, so it was not compared against the cause
